沿[from.GetName]的构造断层线探测到了不稳定的能量波动。

这些波动的根源无法从轨道上加以确定。需要近距离研究才能弄清该现象的源头。
excerpt.en:
Erratic energy surges are being detected along the tectonic fault lines of [from.GetName].

The origin of these spikes cannot be ascertained from orbit. Closer study will be required to identify the source of this phenomenon.

texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]的地质分析找到了之前在轨道上发现的异常能量波动的源头。

这颗行星活跃的地质活动在冻土不稳定的地区产生了剧烈的静电放电。

这种火山闪电向天空爆发，将周围的空气电离。这一事件释放的极端热量形成热冲击，然后固化成闪电状的结构。

利用地质分析获得的知识，我们可以轻易地预测这些地震爆发，并对其加以利用。
texts.en:
Geological analysis of [from.GetName] has identified the source of the erratic energy spikes detected during initial orbital surveys.

The planet's volatile tectonic activity produces violent electrostatic discharges in regions with unstable frozen tundra.

This volcanic lightning erupts skywards turning the surrounding air to plasma. The extreme heat unleashed by this event produces a thermal shock which then solidifies into lightning-shaped structures.

Using what we have learned from the geological analysis, we will be able to easily predict these seismic eruptions and exploit this phenomenon for our own purposes.

summary.text:
# 能量波动 / Erratic Surges

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:519; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1474 (extreme_frontiers.310)

## 如何开始 How it starts

冰冻星球可能生成（5级，权重3，全局一次 max_once；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a frozen planet (level 5, weight 3, once per game via max_once; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.310“固化等离子航迹”：星球获得 d_energy_10 矿藏，帝国获得每月能量加成。

Single result extreme_frontiers.310 "Solidified Plasma Trails": the planet gains a d_energy_10 deposit and the empire monthly energy.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
